name: io.github.jkbngb/handelsregister
title: Handelsregister
description: German Handelsregister + Austrian Firmenbuch for AI agents: master data, financials & ratios.

headers.name: X-API-Key
headers.description: API key created in the web app (https://app.agentic-firmenbuch.at, Konto → API-Keys); only needed where no browser login is possible. New accounts get 50 free credits for 7 days; after that MCP/API access needs the Pro plan (79 EUR/month, unlimited within fair use). Clients with OAuth support authenticate via the server's OAuth-protected-resource metadata instead (e-mail code, no key).
